create_ScoreLogger: create a ScoreLogger instance initialized with a dictionary of score fields to track
incorporate_results_ScoreLogger: call incorporate_results on a ScoreLogger to compare new scores and update if improved
logging_to_file_ScoreLogger: call logging_to_file on a ScoreLogger to save the logged results history to a JSON file
gen_file_prefix: generate a timestamped directory path for saving model checkpoints under a given model name
get_cur_time_str: get the current date and time formatted as a string like MM-DD[HH:MM:SS]
